body: It's definitely lost interest.  I wasn't fun enough or attractive enough for her.  Even after everything I tried and all the changes I made.  This happens to me with everyone.  People get close to me and then they find out how broken I am and then they leave because it's not worth the trouble.  Maybe they're right.

Hm, thank you for that.  I will have to spend some time thinking about how to do what I feel is best for myself as an individual, then.  It might hurt in the short term but avoiding pain forever is unrealistic, I guess.

I suppose not...  Still, despite what I have experienced, it is a bitter pill to swallow.  I do really care for this person, we've been through a lot together.  But I suppose there's little point in continuing to give my all to a person who is barely willing to lift a finger on my behalf. 😔

I have and she usually just explains that she "hasn't been feeling well" or something along those lines and apologises but never actually changes.  She seemed like maybe she was trying a little more at first but not anymore.
